item.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated an allegation that a senior doctor tried to pressure a registrar to change a patient's recorded date of death.
item.support: It was alleged that an executive officer attempted to coerce a Medical Service Registrar into changing the date of death

item.text: The Commission did not substantiate the allegation and decided to take no further action.
item.support: The investigation did not substantiate the allegation. The Commission will therefore take no further action.

item.text: The Commission identified risks in reliance on paper medical records after clinical notes could not be located.
item.support: It did, however, highlight the serious misconduct risks in relying on paper records.

item.quote: The Commission has completed its investigation and has not identified serious misconduct in relation to the allegation.
